description: Portal engagement per client: events and active people (Apex Portal Activity).
expression: SELECT COUNT(Apex_Portal_Activity__dlm.Event_Id__c) AS events__c, APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(Apex_Portal_Activity__dlm.Portal_User_Id__c) AS active_people__c, Apex_Portal_Activity__dlm.Client_Id__c AS client_id__c FROM Apex_Portal_Activity__dlm GROUP BY client_id__c
